function doPost(e) {
  var r, lock, version=2;
  try {

    try{r=JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);}catch(_){fail_('INVALID_REQUEST','요청 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.');}
    if(!plain_(r)||[1,2].indexOf(r.apiVersion)<0)fail_('INVALID_REQUEST','게임과 저장 서버를 최신 버전으로 갱신해 주세요.');

    if(['session','logout','changePassword','load','save'].indexOf(r.operation)<0)fail_('INVALID_REQUEST','지원하지 않는 요청입니다.');
    var auth=session_(book,r.sessionToken);
    if(r.operation==='session')return json_({ok:true,apiVersion:2,playerId:auth.player.values[0],loginId:auth.player.values[4],expiresAt:auth.values[3]});
    if(r.operation==='logout'){table_(book,'Sessions').getRange(auth.row,6).setValue(new Date().toISOString());return json_({ok:true,apiVersion:2});}

      if(!verifyPassword_(auth.player.values,r.currentPassword))fail_('AUTH_FAILED','현재 비밀번호가 일치하지 않습니다.');

    }

function loginId_(value) {
  if(typeof value!=='string')fail_('INVALID_ID','아이디는 영문·숫자·밑줄·하이픈 3~64자로 입력해 주세요.');

}
function password_(value){if(typeof value!=='string'||Array.from(value).length<8||Array.from(value).length>128)fail_('PASSWORD_LENGTH','비밀번호는 8~128자로 입력해 주세요. 공백과 대소문자를 그대로 구분합니다.');return value;}
function randomSecret_(){return Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'')+Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g,'');}
function passwordHash_(password,salt,iterations){
  var bytes=function(s){return Uint8Array.from(Utilities.newBlob(s).getBytes().map(function(b){return (b+256)%256;}));};
  return RpgPasswordCrypto.pbkdf2Hex(bytes(password),bytes(salt),iterations);
}
function verifyPassword_(p,password){
  var iterations=Number(p[7]);if(!p[5]||!p[6]||iterations!==RPG_ITERATIONS_)return false;
  return equal_(p[5],passwordHash_(password,p[6],iterations));
}
function players_(book){var s=table_(book,'Players');return s.getLastRow()>1?s.getRange(2,1,s.getLastRow()-1,RPG_HEADERS_.Players.length).getValues().map(function(v,i){return {row:i+2,values:v};}):[];}
function player_(book,id){
  var found=players_(book).filter(function(p){return String(p.values[4]||p.values[0]).trim().toLowerCase()===id;});
  if(found.length>1)fail_('ACCOUNT_CONFLICT','기존 아이디가 중복됩니다. 운영자에게 계정 확인을 요청해 주세요.');return found[0]||null;
}
function enabled_(p){return p&&(p.values[2]===true||p.values[2]==='TRUE');}
function writePlayer_(book,p){table_(book,'Players').getRange(p.row,1,1,RPG_HEADERS_.Players.length).setValues([p.values]);}
function setPassword_(book,p,password){
  p.values[6]=randomSecret_();p.values[7]=RPG_ITERATIONS_;p.values[5]=passwordHash_(password,p.values[6],p.values[7]);
  p.values[8]=(Number(p.values[8])||0)+1;p.values[1]='';p.values[9]='';p.values[10]='';writePlayer_(book,p);
}
function authenticate_(book,r){
  var id=loginId_(r.playerId);
  throttle_(book,'global-auth',100,60000);throttle_(book,'auth:'+id,8,15*60*1000);
  var p=player_(book,id);
  if(r.operation==='signup'){
    password_(r.password);
    if(p)fail_('ID_EXISTS','이미 사용 중인 아이디입니다.');
    var s=table_(book,'Players');p={row:s.getLastRow()+1,values:[id,'',true,new Date().toISOString(),id,'','',RPG_ITERATIONS_,0,'','']};
    setPassword_(book,p,r.password);
  } else if(r.operation==='login'){
    password_(r.password);
    if(!p||!enabled_(p)||!p.values[5]){
      // Comparable KDF work for unknown and legacy accounts.
      passwordHash_(r.password,'lumos-unregistered-account-dummy-salt',RPG_ITERATIONS_);
      fail_('AUTH_FAILED','아이디 또는 비밀번호를 확인해 주세요. 이전 복구키 계정은 계정 전환을 선택해 주세요.');
    }
    if(!verifyPassword_(p.values,r.password))fail_('AUTH_FAILED','아이디 또는 비밀번호를 확인해 주세요.');
  } else {
    password_(r.newPassword);
    if(!enabled_(p))fail_('AUTH_FAILED','계정과 인증 정보를 확인해 주세요.');
    if(r.operation==='migrateLegacy'){
      if(p.values[5]||typeof r.legacyKey!=='string'||r.legacyKey.length<32||r.legacyKey.length>256||!p.values[1]||!equal_(String(p.values[1]).toLowerCase(),sha256_(r.legacyKey)))fail_('AUTH_FAILED','이전 아이디와 복구키를 확인해 주세요. 키를 잃어버렸다면 운영자에게 요청해 주세요.');
    }else if(typeof r.resetCode!=='string'||r.resetCode.length!==64||!p.values[9]||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(p.values[10]))||Date.parse(p.values[10])<=Date.now()||!equal_(p.values[9],sha256_(r.resetCode)))fail_('RESET_INVALID','초기화 코드가 올바르지 않거나 만료되었습니다. 운영자에게 다시 요청해 주세요.');
    setPassword_(book,p,r.newPassword);
  }
  return issueSession_(book,p,r.remember===true);
}
function issueSession_(book,p,remember){
  var token=randomSecret_(),now=Date.now(),expires=new Date(now+(remember?30:1)*86400000).toISOString();
  var s=table_(book,'Sessions'),rows=s.getLastRow()>1?s.getRange(2,1,s.getLastRow()-1,6).getValues():[];
  var reusable=rows.findIndex(function(v){return !!v[5]||Date.parse(v[3])<=now;});
  var row=[sha256_(token),p.values[0],Number(p.values[8]),expires,new Date(now).toISOString(),''];
  if(reusable>=0)s.getRange(reusable+2,1,1,6).setValues([row]);else s.appendRow(row);
  return {ok:true,apiVersion:2,playerId:p.values[0],loginId:p.values[4],sessionToken:token,expiresAt:expires};
}
function session_(book,token){
  if(typeof token!=='string'||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(token))fail_('SESSION_EXPIRED','로그인이 만료되었습니다. 기기 진행은 유지되며 다시 로그인할 수 있습니다.');
  var s=table_(book,'Sessions'),hash=sha256_(token),rows=s.getLastRow()>1?s.getRange(2,1,s.getLastRow()-1,6).getValues():[];
  var index=rows.findIndex(function(v){return equal_(v[0],hash);});
  if(index<0)fail_('SESSION_EXPIRED','다시 로그인해 주세요. 기기 진행은 유지됩니다.');
  var v=rows[index],p=players_(book).find(function(p){return p.values[0]===v[1];});
  if(v[5]||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(v[3]))||Date.parse(v[3])<=Date.now()||!enabled_(p)||Number(p.values[8])!==Number(v[2]))fail_('SESSION_EXPIRED','로그인이 만료되거나 해제되었습니다. 기기 진행은 유지됩니다.');
  return {row:index+2,values:v,player:p};
}
function throttle_(book,key,limit,windowMs){
  var s=table_(book,'AuthLimits');
  // Fixed buckets bound storage even when an attacker changes IDs. Collisions
  // only make a limit stricter; they never bypass it. Global bucket is separate.
  var bucket=key==='global-auth'?0:1+parseInt(sha256_(key).slice(0,8),16)%1024;
  var row=bucket+2,v=s.getRange(row,1,1,3).getValues()[0],now=Date.now();
  if(!v[1]||now-Number(v[1])>=windowMs)v=[bucket,now,0];
  if(Number(v[2])>=limit)fail_('RATE_LIMITED','시도가 너무 많습니다. 잠시 기다린 뒤 다시 시도해 주세요.');
  v[2]=Number(v[2])+1;s.getRange(row,1,1,3).setValues([v]);
}

/** Run once from the editor. Adds columns/tables without touching saves. */
function setupRpgSheets(){
  var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(10000);
  try{
    var book=workbook_();
    // Validate every existing prefix before making any changes.
    Object.keys(RPG_HEADERS_).forEach(function(name){var s=book.getSheetByName(name);if(!s||!s.getLastRow())return;var existing=s.getRange(1,1,1,s.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];if(existing.some(function(h,i){return h!==RPG_HEADERS_[name][i];}))throw new Error('Unexpected headers in '+name+'. Back up and check the sheet before migration.');});
    Object.keys(RPG_HEADERS_).forEach(function(name){var s=book.getSheetByName(name)||book.insertSheet(name);if(s.getMaxColumns()<RPG_HEADERS_[name].length)s.insertColumnsAfter(s.getMaxColumns(),RPG_HEADERS_[name].length-s.getMaxColumns());s.getRange(1,1,1,RPG_HEADERS_[name].length).setValues([RPG_HEADERS_[name]]);s.setFrozenRows(1);});
    var limits=table_(book,'AuthLimits');if(limits.getMaxRows()<1026)limits.insertRowsAfter(limits.getMaxRows(),1026-limits.getMaxRows());
    players_(book).forEach(function(p){if(!p.values[4]){p.values[4]=String(p.values[0]).trim().toLowerCase();p.values[8]=Number(p.values[8])||0;writePlayer_(book,p);}});
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
}
function setupRpgSheets_(){setupRpgSheets();}
/** Operator must verify ownership outside the game before issuing a reset. */
function resetPlayerPassword(){
  var ui=SpreadsheetApp.getUi(),answer=ui.prompt('계정 비밀번호 초기화','본인 확인을 마친 계정의 아이디를 입력하세요. 초기화 코드는 해당 사용자에게만 전달하세요.',ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL);
  if(answer.getSelectedButton()!==ui.Button.OK)return;
  var code=issuePasswordReset_(answer.getResponseText());
  ui.alert('일회용 초기화 코드 (24시간 유효)',code+'\n\n게임 → 로그인 → 비밀번호를 잊었어요에서 사용합니다. 시트나 공개 게시물에 원문을 저장하지 마세요.',ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}
function issuePasswordReset_(id){
  var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();lock.waitLock(10000);
  try{var book=workbook_(),p=player_(book,loginId_(id));if(!enabled_(p))throw new Error('Account is missing or disabled.');var code=randomSecret_();p.values[9]=sha256_(code);p.values[10]=new Date(Date.now()+86400000).toISOString();p.values[8]=(Number(p.values[8])||0)+1;p.values[5]='';p.values[1]='';writePlayer_(book,p);return code;}finally{lock.releaseLock();}
}

function benchmarkPasswordHash(){var start=Date.now();passwordHash_('benchmark-only-password','benchmark-only-salt',RPG_ITERATIONS_);SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('비밀번호 처리 시간: '+(Date.now()-start)+' ms. 수초 이상이면 운영 규모를 줄이거나 별도 인증 서버를 검토하세요.');}

function saveOperation_(book, request, apiVersion) {
    var saved = readEnvelope_(book, request.playerId, request.slotId);
    if (request.operation === 'load') {
      if (!saved.envelope) fail_('NOT_FOUND', '이 슬롯에는 클라우드 저장이 없습니다.');
      return json_({ok: true, apiVersion: apiVersion, revision: saved.envelope.revision, savedAt: saved.envelope.savedAt, save: saved.envelope.save});
    }
    var hash = sha256_(canonical_({apiVersion: apiVersion, playerId: request.playerId, slotId: request.slotId, baseRevision: request.baseRevision, save: request.save}));
    var previous = saved.envelope;
    var recent = previous ? previous.recentRequests : [];
    var already = recent.filter(function (x) { return x.requestId === request.requestId; })[0];
    if (already) {
      if (!equal_(already.payloadHash, hash)) fail_('REQUEST_ID_REUSED', '같은 저장 번호에 다른 데이터가 전달되었습니다.');
      return json_({ok: true, apiVersion: apiVersion, requestId: request.requestId, revision: already.revision, savedAt: already.savedAt});
    }
    var revision = previous ? previous.revision : 0;
    if (request.baseRevision !== revision) fail_('REVISION_CONFLICT', '다른 저장과 충돌했습니다. 양쪽 진행을 보존한 뒤 선택해 주세요.', false, revision);
    validateSave_(request.save);
    var savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    var receipt = {requestId: request.requestId, payloadHash: hash, revision: revision + 1, savedAt: savedAt};
    var envelope = {revision: revision + 1, savedAt: savedAt, save: request.save, recentRequests: recent.concat([receipt]).slice(-32)};
    var raw = JSON.stringify(envelope);
    if (raw.length > RPG_LIMIT_) fail_('SAVE_TOO_LARGE', '저장 데이터가 현재 형식의 크기 한도를 넘었습니다.');
    var table = table_(book, 'Saves');
    if (saved.row) table.getRange(saved.row, 3).setValue(raw);
    else table.getRange(table.getLastRow() + 1, 1, 1, 3).setValues([[request.playerId, request.slotId, raw]]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    // Backups are secondary; their failure must never reverse an acknowledged main write.
    if (previous && chapterAdvanced_(previous.save, request.save)) {
      try { table_(book, 'Backups').appendRow([request.playerId, request.slotId, previous.revision, JSON.stringify(previous), 'chapter-complete']); } catch (_) {}
    }
    return json_({ok: true, apiVersion: apiVersion, requestId: request.requestId, revision: envelope.revision, savedAt: savedAt});
}

function json_(value) { return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(value)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON); }
function fail_(code, message, retryable, revision) { var e = new Error(message); e.rpgCode = code; e.retryable = !!retryable; if (revision !== undefined) e.currentRevision = revision; throw e; }
function workbook_() { var id = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('RPG_SPREADSHEET_ID'); if (!id) fail_('SERVER_NOT_CONFIGURED', '저장 서버 설정이 완료되지 않았습니다.'); return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id); }
function table_(book, name) {
  var sheet = book.getSheetByName(name);
  var expected = RPG_HEADERS_[name];
  if (!sheet || JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, expected.length).getValues()[0]) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) fail_('SERVER_NOT_CONFIGURED', '저장 표 설정을 확인해 주세요.');
  return sheet;
}
function sha256_(text) { return Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, text, Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).map(function (n) { return ('0' + ((n + 256) % 256).toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join(''); }
function equal_(a, b) { if (typeof a !== 'string' || typeof b !== 'string' || a.length !== b.length) return false; var difference = 0; for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) difference |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i); return difference === 0; }
function canonical_(v) { if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return JSON.stringify(v); if (Array.isArray(v)) return '[' + v.map(canonical_).join(',') + ']'; return '{' + Object.keys(v).sort().map(function (k) { return JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + canonical_(v[k]); }).join(',') + '}'; }
function requirePlayer_(book, playerId, token) {
  var sheet = table_(book, 'Players');
  var rows = sheet.getLastRow() > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 4).getValues() : [];
  var matches = rows.filter(function (r) { return r[0] === playerId; });
  if (matches.length !== 1 || !(matches[0][2] === true || matches[0][2] === 'TRUE') || !equal_(String(matches[0][1]).toLowerCase(), sha256_(token))) fail_('UNAUTHORIZED', '플레이어 ID와 개인 저장키를 확인해 주세요.');
}
function readEnvelope_(book, playerId, slotId) {
  var sheet = table_(book, 'Saves');
  var rows = sheet.getLastRow() > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 3).getValues() : [];
  var found = [];
  rows.forEach(function (r, index) { if (r[0] === playerId && r[1] === slotId) found.push({row: index + 2, raw: r[2]}); });
  if (!found.length) return {row: null, envelope: null};
  if (found.length !== 1 || typeof found[0].raw !== 'string' || found[0].raw.length > RPG_LIMIT_) fail_('STORED_SAVE_INVALID', '서버 저장을 복구해야 합니다. 원본은 보존되었습니다.');
  var value;
  try { value = JSON.parse(found[0].raw); } catch (_) { fail_('STORED_SAVE_INVALID', '서버 저장을 읽을 수 없습니다. 원본은 보존되었습니다.'); }
  if (!value || !Number.isSafeInteger(value.revision) || value.revision < 1 || !Array.isArray(value.recentRequests) || typeof value.savedAt !== 'string') fail_('STORED_SAVE_INVALID', '서버 저장 형식을 확인해 주세요.');
  try { validateSave_(value.save); } catch (_) { fail_('STORED_SAVE_INVALID', '서버 저장을 복구해야 합니다. 원본은 보존되었습니다.'); }
  return {row: found[0].row, envelope: value};
}
function validateRequest_(r) {
  if (!plain_(r) || r.apiVersion !== 1 || ['load', 'save'].indexOf(r.operation) < 0 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(r.playerId || '') || typeof r.authToken !== 'string' || r.authToken.length < 32 || r.authToken.length > 256 || ['main', 'pre-final'].indexOf(r.slotId) < 0) fail_('INVALID_REQUEST', '요청 형식과 인증 정보를 확인해 주세요.');
  var required = ['apiVersion', 'operation', 'playerId', 'slotId', 'authToken'];
  if (r.operation === 'save') {
    required = required.concat(['requestId', 'baseRevision', 'save']);
    if (typeof r.requestId !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,160}$/.test(r.requestId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(r.baseRevision) || r.baseRevision < 0) fail_('INVALID_REQUEST', '저장 번호와 버전을 확인해 주세요.');
    validateSave_(r.save);
  }
  if (!keys_(r, required)) fail_('INVALID_REQUEST', '지원하지 않는 요청 필드입니다.');
}
function plain_(v) { return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v); }
function keys_(v, expected) { return plain_(v) && JSON.stringify(Object.keys(v).sort()) === JSON.stringify(expected.slice().sort()); }
function number_(v, integer) { return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 1000000000 && (!integer || Number.isSafeInteger(v)); }
function string_(v) { return typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0 && v.length <= 200; }
function list_(v, pattern) { return Array.isArray(v) && v.length <= 2000 && v.every(function (x) { return string_(x) && (!pattern || pattern.test(x)); }) && (new Set(v)).size === v.length; }
function dict_(v, validator) { return plain_(v) && Object.keys(v).length <= 2000 && Object.keys(v).every(function (key) { return string_(key) && key !== '__proto__' && key !== 'constructor' && key !== 'prototype' && validator(v[key], key); }); }
function contentId_(id, prefix) { var m = /^([SIPW])(\d{3})$/.exec(id || ''); return !!m && (!prefix || m[1] === prefix) && Number(m[2]) >= 1 && Number(m[2]) <= ({S:83,I:64,P:44,W:20})[m[1]]; }
function cursor_(c) { var counts = [0,12,13,14,16,16,18,42]; var m = c && /^([1-7])-(\d{2})$/.exec(c.subchapterId || ''); return keys_(c, ['chapterId','subchapterId','checkpointId']) && !!m && Number(m[2]) >= 1 && Number(m[2]) <= counts[Number(m[1])] && c.chapterId === 'ch0' + m[1] && string_(c.checkpointId); }
function validateSave_(s) {
  if (!plain_(s) || s.schemaVersion !== 1) fail_('SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED', '지원하지 않는 저장 형식입니다.');
  if (s.contentVersion !== 'campaign-v1' || s.campaignId !== 'magic-typing-rpg') fail_('CONTENT_UNSUPPORTED', '지원하지 않는 게임 데이터입니다.');
  var valid = keys_(s, ['schemaVersion','contentVersion','campaignId','cursor','mode','recollectionReturn','progress','player','inventory','loadout','world','checkpoint','stats']) && cursor_(s.cursor) && ['story','recollection'].indexOf(s.mode) >= 0 && (s.mode === 'story' ? s.recollectionReturn === null : cursor_(s.recollectionReturn));
  var p=s.progress, v=s.player, inv=s.inventory, w=s.world, cp=s.checkpoint;
  valid = valid && keys_(p, ['completedChapterIds','completedSubchapterIds','completedObjectiveIds','flags','quests','storyItems']) && list_(p.completedChapterIds,/^ch0[1-7]$/) && list_(p.completedSubchapterIds,/^[1-7]-\d{2}$/) && list_(p.completedObjectiveIds) && dict_(p.flags,function(x){return typeof x==='boolean'||(typeof x==='number'&&isFinite(x)&&Math.abs(x)<=1e9)||(typeof x==='string'&&x.length<=2000)||(Array.isArray(x)&&x.length<=500&&x.every(function(y){return typeof y==='string'&&y.length<=500;}));}) && dict_(p.quests,function(x){return ['available','active','completed'].indexOf(x)>=0;}) && dict_(p.storyItems,function(x,id){return contentId_(id)&&['owned','used','destroyed'].indexOf(x)>=0;});
  valid = valid && keys_(v,['hp','mana','learnedSpells','spellMastery','abilityUnlocks','growthRewardIds','permanentGains','healingChargesRemaining'].concat(v.spellUpgrades===undefined?[]:['spellUpgrades'])) && number_(v.hp) && number_(v.mana) && list_(v.learnedSpells) && v.learnedSpells.every(function(id){return contentId_(id,'S');}) && dict_(v.spellMastery,function(x,id){return contentId_(id,'S')&&number_(x,true);}) && list_(v.abilityUnlocks) && list_(v.growthRewardIds) && dict_(v.permanentGains,function(x){return number_(x);}) && (v.healingChargesRemaining===null||number_(v.healingChargesRemaining,true));
  if(v.spellUpgrades!==undefined)valid=valid&&dict_(v.spellUpgrades,function(u,id){return contentId_(id,'S')&&v.learnedSpells.indexOf(id)>=0&&plain_(u)&&Object.keys(u).every(function(k){return ['power','control','shape'].indexOf(k)>=0;})&&(u.power===undefined||number_(u.power,true)&&u.power<=3)&&(u.control===undefined||number_(u.control,true)&&u.control<=2)&&(u.shape===undefined||['pierce','spread','focus'].indexOf(u.shape)>=0);});
  valid = valid && keys_(inv,['gold','stacks','equipment']) && number_(inv.gold,true) && dict_(inv.stacks,function(x,id){return contentId_(id,'I')&&number_(x,true);}) && Array.isArray(inv.equipment) && inv.equipment.length<=200;
  if (!valid) fail_('INVALID_SAVE','저장 필드와 수치를 확인해 주세요.');
  var equipment={};
  inv.equipment.forEach(function(e){ if(!keys_(e,['instanceId','catalogId','upgrades','chargesRemaining'])||!string_(e.instanceId)||equipment[e.instanceId]||!contentId_(e.catalogId)||!/^[WP]/.test(e.catalogId)||!dict_(e.upgrades,function(x){return number_(x,true);})||!(e.chargesRemaining===null||number_(e.chargesRemaining,true))) fail_('INVALID_SAVE','장비 정보를 확인해 주세요.'); equipment[e.instanceId]=e; });
  var load=s.loadout;
  valid = keys_(load,['wandInstanceId','pendantInstanceIds'].concat(load.quickSlots===undefined?[]:['quickSlots'])) && (load.wandInstanceId===null||(equipment[load.wandInstanceId]&&equipment[load.wandInstanceId].catalogId[0]==='W')) && Array.isArray(load.pendantInstanceIds) && load.pendantInstanceIds.length===3;
  if(load.quickSlots!==undefined)valid=valid&&Array.isArray(load.quickSlots)&&load.quickSlots.length===4&&load.quickSlots.every(function(id){return id===null||['I001','I002','I003','I004','I006','I007','I008','I009','I010','I012','I013','I014','I029'].indexOf(id)>=0;});
  if(valid){var used=load.pendantInstanceIds.filter(function(x){return x!==null;});valid=list_(used)&&used.every(function(x){return equipment[x]&&equipment[x].catalogId[0]==='P';});}
  valid = valid && keys_(w,['claimedRewardIds','shopUnlockIds','shopOffers','processedTransactionIds']) && list_(w.claimedRewardIds) && list_(w.shopUnlockIds) && list_(w.processedTransactionIds) && dict_(w.shopOffers,function(x){return keys_(x,['remaining','purchased'])&&(x.remaining===null||number_(x.remaining,true))&&number_(x.purchased,true);});
  valid = valid && keys_(cp,['id','bossPhaseId','hp','mana','personalConsumables','temporarySupplies','cooldownsSeconds','healingChargesRemaining','equipmentCharges'].concat(!cp||cp.battle===undefined?[]:['battle'])) && cp.id===s.cursor.checkpointId && (cp.bossPhaseId===null||string_(cp.bossPhaseId)) && number_(cp.hp) && number_(cp.mana) && dict_(cp.personalConsumables,function(x,id){return contentId_(id,'I')&&number_(x,true);}) && dict_(cp.temporarySupplies,function(x,id){return /^(SUP_|MISSION_)/.test(id)&&number_(x,true);}) && dict_(cp.cooldownsSeconds,function(x){return number_(x);}) && (cp.healingChargesRemaining===null||number_(cp.healingChargesRemaining,true)) && dict_(cp.equipmentCharges,function(x,id){return !!equipment[id]&&(x===null||number_(x,true));});
  if(cp&&cp.battle!==undefined){
    var battle=cp.battle;
    valid=valid&&keys_(battle,['sceneId','spawn','objectiveIds','flags'])&&battle.sceneId===s.cursor.subchapterId&&keys_(battle.spawn,['x','z'])&&number_(battle.spawn.x)&&number_(battle.spawn.z)&&list_(battle.objectiveIds)&&dict_(battle.flags,function(x){return typeof x==='boolean'||(typeof x==='number'&&isFinite(x)&&Math.abs(x)<=1e9)||(typeof x==='string'&&x.length<=2000)||(Array.isArray(x)&&x.length<=500&&x.every(function(y){return typeof y==='string'&&y.length<=500;}));});
  }
  valid = valid && keys_(s.stats,['playTimeSeconds']) && number_(s.stats.playTimeSeconds);
  if(!valid || JSON.stringify(s).length>RPG_LIMIT_) fail_('INVALID_SAVE','저장 필드와 수치를 확인해 주세요.');
}
function chapterAdvanced_(oldSave,newSave){return newSave.progress.completedChapterIds.length>oldSave.progress.completedChapterIds.length;}
